# 2 Baruch Chapter 2 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**1** "I have not forgotten the suffering of my people. It is set aside only for a while.

**2** At the end of time I will remember them and bring them back. The name of Israel will never be wiped out.

**3** Then their enemies will fall and those who opposed Israel will be destroyed, and Israel will rise high.

**4** Those who were brought low will be raised up, and those who were raised high will be brought low.

**5** I will punish those who oppressed my people, discipline those who trampled them, and comfort everyone who has grieved for Zion.

**6** Israel has not been handed over to destruction. Those scattered among the nations have not been lost from the Lord's sight.

**7** The Lord made the world for Israel's sake. It was not because he loved just any people that he did all this — he set his purpose on them from the very beginning."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. V.4 rendered as an eschatological reversal, keeping the poetic balance. V.7 preserves the election theology — creation is for Israel — without losing readability.*
